title: When the Monsoon Breaks
author: J. M. Lockridge
blurb: Quentin Vane, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
